To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the inference of haplotypes from genotype data is an NP-hard problem; (ii) we have developed an algorithm that is practical, in that it is fast and finds optimal solutions on simulated data; (iii) the algorithm is based on integer linear programming, and is thus deterministic.
